{"status":"available","text":"本文的方法贡献由 task、model、data 三部分构成：新的 promptable segmentation 任务、可提示模型 Segment Anything Model (SAM)，以及由 data engine 构建的 SA-1B（E002, E008）。

promptable segmentation 要求给定任意分割提示——前景/背景点、粗略框或掩码、自由文本等——返回一个有效的分割掩码；「有效」意味着即使提示有歧义、可能对应多个对象，输出也应至少是其中一个对象的合理掩码（E024, E011）。该任务既用作预训练目标，也通过 prompt engineering 迁移到下游分割任务（E024）。预训练时对每个训练样本模拟一串提示（如点、框、掩码），并把模型预测的掩码与真值比较（E025）。

SAM 由 image encoder、prompt encoder 与 mask decoder 三部分组成（E039）。image encoder 采用 MAE 预训练的 Vision Transformer (ViT)，具体为 ViT-H/16，使用 14×14 windowed attention 与四个等间隔的 global attention blocks（E204）。输入经缩放并把短边填充到 1024×1024，输出 16× 下采样的图像嵌入，即 64×64；由于每张图只需计算一次、不随提示重复，image encoder 可以承担较大的 FLOPs（E205, E204）。通道维度先用 1×1 卷积降到 256，再接一层 3×3、256 通道卷积（E205）。

prompt encoder 区分 sparse（点、框、文本）与 dense（掩码）两类提示，并把稀疏提示映射为 256 维向量嵌入（E041, E205）。点表示为该点位置的 positional encoding 与两个可学习嵌入之一的和，这两个嵌入分别指示该点属于前景还是背景；框表示为一对嵌入：左上角位置的 positional encoding 与表示「top-left corner」的可学习嵌入相加，右下角同理（E205）。自由文本使用 CLIP 的文本编码器（E205）。掩码属于 dense 提示，与图像嵌入有空间对应：以输入图像 1/4 的分辨率输入，再经两个 2×2、stride 2 卷积合计下采样 4×，输出通道分别为 4 和 16，最后由 1×1 卷积映射到 256 通道，并与图像嵌入逐元素相加；若没有掩码提示，则向每个图像嵌入位置加入表示「no mask」的可学习嵌入（E206, E215）。

mask decoder 把图像嵌入、提示嵌入与一个 output token 映射为掩码（E042）。每个解码层依次执行：token 上的 self-attention；以 token 为 query 对图像嵌入做 cross-attention；逐 token 的 MLP；再以图像嵌入为 query 对 token 做 cross-attention，用提示信息更新图像嵌入（E217）。positional encoding 在图像嵌入参与注意力时被加到图像嵌入上，原始提示 token（含位置编码）也被重新加回（E220）。运行两层后，图像嵌入经两个转置卷积上采样 4×，token 再对图像嵌入做一次注意力，更新后的 output token 经 3 层 MLP 得到与上采样图像嵌入通道数相同的向量，最终通过两者逐空间位置的乘积预测掩码（E223）。嵌入维度为 256，MLP 内部维度 2048 但只作用于数量很少的提示 token，cross-attention 中 query/key/value 的通道维度减半到 128，全部注意力使用 8 个头（E224）。

为处理歧义，模型对单个提示并行预测多个掩码，默认 3 个（常对应整体、部分、子部分这一至多三层的嵌套结构），训练时只对损失最小的那个掩码反传（E043, E226）。模型另用一个头预测每个掩码与目标之间的 IoU，用于给掩码排序（E226）。当输入多于一个提示时歧义罕见，此时只预测并返回一个掩码（E227）。给定预计算的图像嵌入，prompt encoder 与 mask decoder 可在浏览器 CPU 上约 50ms 内完成预测，支持实时交互（E044）。

掩码损失是 focal loss 与 dice loss 的线性组合，比例为 20:1；IoU 预测头用均方误差损失训练，以常数 1.0 的权重加到掩码损失上（E228）。训练模拟交互式分割：以相等概率选取一个前景点或目标掩码的包围框作为首个提示；点从真值掩码中均匀采样，框取真值掩码的包围框并在每个坐标上加噪声，噪声标准差为框边长的 10%、上限 20 像素（E229）。后续点从上一轮预测与真值之间的误差区域均匀采样，落在假阴性处作为前景点、假阳性处作为背景点，并把上一轮未阈值化的 mask logits 也作为提示输入（E230）。模型共训练 11 轮：1 个初始提示、8 个迭代采样点，以及两次不提供新信息、让模型自我修正的迭代（E231）。训练使用 AdamW，90k 次迭代（约 2 个 SA-1B epoch），batch size 256，从 MAE 预训练的 ViT-H 初始化，分布在 256 块 GPU 上，每块 GPU 最多随机取 64 个掩码，并轻度过滤掉覆盖图像 90% 以上的掩码（E236, E238）。

数据方面，互联网上并没有现成的分割掩码，作者因此构建 data engine，让模型与数据标注互相迭代，包含 assisted-manual、semi-automatic、fully automatic 三个阶段（E047）。第一阶段由专业标注员在 SAM 驱动的浏览器交互工具中点击前景/背景点来标注掩码，并用像素级 brush 与 eraser 修正；不施加语义约束，按对象显著程度标注，单个掩码超过 30 秒即可进入下一张图（E048）。模型从公开分割数据集起步，之后只用新标注掩码重训，共重训 6 次，image encoder 由 ViT-B 扩到 ViT-H；单掩码平均标注时间从 34 秒降到 14 秒，每图平均掩码数从 20 增至 44，该阶段共从 120k 图像收集 4.3M 掩码（E050）。第二阶段为提升掩码多样性，先用第一阶段掩码训练一个通用「object」类别的包围框检测器以自动检测高置信掩码，标注员在预填这些掩码的图像上补充标注其余对象，新增 5.9M 掩码（总计 10.2M），模型重训 5 次，每图掩码数从 44 升至 72（E050）。第三阶段完全自动：用 32×32 规则点网格提示歧义感知模型，每个点预测一组可能对应有效对象的掩码，由 IoU 预测模块筛出高置信掩码，并只保留稳定掩码（若在 0.5−δ 与 0.5+δ 处阈值化概率图得到相似掩码即视为稳定），再用 NMS 去除重复，另外处理多个重叠的放大裁剪以改善小掩码质量（E050, E052）。该流程应用于全部 11M 图像，共产生 1.1B 掩码，其中 99.1% 完全自动生成（E052, E056）。SA-1B 因此包含 11M 经授权、保护隐私的图像与 1.1B 掩码；图像平均约 3300×4950 像素，发布时最短边下采样到 1500 像素，人脸与车牌被模糊处理，且数据集只包含自动生成的掩码（E014, E056）。

此外，文本提示的变体在训练时对面积大于 100 的手工标注掩码提取 CLIP 图像嵌入，并把它作为 SAM 的首个交互提示；由于 CLIP 的图像嵌入与文本嵌入对齐，推理时可直接把 CLIP 文本编码器输出的文本嵌入作为提示（E180, E313）。","sources":["E002","E008","E011","E014","E024","E025","E039","E041","E042","E043","E044","E047","E048","E050","E052","E056","E180","E204","E205","E206","E215","E217","E220","E223","E224","E226","E227","E228","E229","E230","E231","E236","E238","E313"]}

The task: review the draft against sources and return corrected JSON in same format (status/text/sources). I need to check claims carefully.

Let me verify key claims:

- E002: SAM and SA-1B released, 1B masks on 11M images. ok.
- E008: three components task, model, data questions. ok.
- E024: promptable segmentation task definition, prompt can be points, boxes, mask, free-form text. ok.
- E011: prompt includes spatial or text info; valid mask requirement. ok.
- E039: three components: image encoder, flexible prompt encoder, fast mask decoder. ok.
- E204: ViT-H/16 with 14×14 windowed attention and four equally-spaced global attention blocks. ok. MAE pre-trained ViT.
- E205: input resolution 1024×1024 by rescaling and padding shorter side; image embedding 64×64; 1×1 conv to 256 channels then 3×3 conv 256 channels. Point: sum of positional encoding of location and one of two learned embeddings indicating foreground/background. Box: embedding pair of top-left and bottom-right. Text: CLIP text encoder. ok.
- E206: dense prompts (masks) input at 4× lower resolution than input image, then downscale additional 4× using two 2×2 stride-2 convolutions with output channels 4 and 16; final 1×1 conv maps channel to 256. Layers separated by GELU and layer norm. ok. Note: draft says "以输入图像 1/4 的分辨率输入，经两个 2×2、stride 2 卷积分别输出 4 与 16 通道" - matches.
- E215: mask and image embedding added element-wise; if no mask prompt, learned embedding representing "no mask" added to each image embedding location. ok.
- E042: mask decoder maps image embedding, prompt embeddings, output token to mask. Modified decoder block uses prompt self-attention and cross-attention in two directions; after two blocks, upsample image embedding and MLP maps output token to dynamic linear classifier, computes mask foreground probability at each image location. ok.
- E217: four steps per decoder layer. ok.
- E220: positional encodings added to image embedding whenever participating in attention; original prompt tokens re-added. ok.
- E223: upsample 4× with two transposed conv layers (now downscaled 4× relative to input image); tokens attend once more to image embedding; output token embedding to small 3-layer MLP outputting vector matching channel dim of upscaled image embedding; mask predicted with spatially point-wise product. Draft says "image embedding经转置卷积上采样4×，output token经三层MLP... 二者做逐空间位置的乘积" - correct point-wise product. But draft omits the intermediate step that tokens attend once more to the image embedding. Minor. Also E221 says upsample by 4× with two transposed convolutional layers. E225 describes transposed convolutions 2×2 stride 2 output channels 64 and 32.
- E224: embedding dimension 256, MLP internal dim 2048 but MLP applied only to prompt tokens; cross-attention reduces channel dim of q,k,v by 2× to 128; 8 heads. Draft says "MLP 内部维度 2048" — should note it's applied to prompt tokens. Fine to add.
- E043: 3 mask outputs; backprop only minimum loss. Draft ok. But note E043 mentions "we found 3 mask outputs is sufficient... nested masks often at most three deep: whole, part, and subpart". Draft says default 3. ok.
- E226: ambiguity-aware; small head estimating IoU. ok. Also E226 mentions single mask averaged problem.
- E227: ambiguity rarer with multiple prompts; only predict single mask when more than one prompt given; fourth output token. Draft says "输入多于一个提示时只返回一个掩码". ok.
- E044: prompt encoder and mask decoder run in web browser, on CPU, in ~50ms. ok.
- E228: focal loss and dice loss in 20:1 ratio; IoU prediction head trained with MSE, added with constant scaling factor 1.0; auxiliary deep supervision unhelpful. ok.
- E229: simulate interactive; equal probability foreground point or bounding box; points sampled uniformly from GT mask; boxes with random noise std = 10% of box sidelength max 20 pixels. ok.
- E230: subsequent points selected from error region; foreground/background if false negative/false positive; supply mask prediction from previous iteration as additional prompt; unthresholded mask logits; when multiple masks returned, use highest predicted IoU. ok.
- E231: diminishing returns after 8 points; two more iterations with no additional points; 11 total iterations. ok.
- E236: AdamW, lr 8e-4 after warmup, 90k iterations (~2 SA-1B epochs), lr decay at 60k and 86666, batch size 256, wd 0.1, drop path 0.4, layer-wise lr decay 0.8, no data augmentation, initialize from MAE ViT-H, 256 GPUs. ok.
- E238: up to 64 randomly sampled masks per GPU; lightly filter SA-1B masks covering >90% of image. ok.
- E047: data engine three stages. ok.
- E048: assisted-manual stage description. ok.
- E050: stage details. Assisted-manual: 4.3M masks from 120k images; retrained 6 times; ViT-B to ViT-H; annotation time 34→14s; masks per image 20→44. Semi-automatic: bbox detector trained on first stage masks with generic "object" category; additional 5.9M masks in 180k images (total 10.2M); retrained 5 times; annotation time back to 34s; masks per image 44→72. Fully automatic: 32×32 grid of points; ambiguity-aware; IoU prediction module selects confident masks; stable masks (thresholding probability map at 0.5−δ and 0.5+δ results in similar masks); NMS; overlapping zoomed-in crops. ok.
- E052: applied to all 11M images, 1.1B masks. ok.
- E056: 99.1% auto; images 3300×4950 avg, released downsampled shortest side 1500; faces and license plates blurred; SA-1B only includes automatically generated masks. Draft ok.
- E180: text-to-mask training: for each manually collected mask with area > 100 extract CLIP image embedding; prompt SAM with CLIP image embeddings as its first interaction; because CLIP image embeddings align with text embeddings, train with image embeddings, use text embeddings at inference. But note: draft says "面积大于 100 的手工标注掩码" — E307 says masks from first two stages, discard masks with area smaller than 100 pixels. E180 says "for each manually collected mask with area larger than 100". Hmm, E180 says manually collected mask; E307 says use masks from the first two stages of our data engine, discard area < 100. Fine. Draft says "手工标注" which matches E180.
- E313: inference uses CLIP text encoder. ok.
- E014: SA-1B >1B masks from 11M licensed privacy-preserving images. ok.

Issues to correct:
1. "点由位置的 positional encoding 与两个可学习嵌入之一相加表示" — correct.
2. Cross-attention direction: step 4 "cross-attention from the image embedding (as queries) to tokens". Draft says "图像嵌入作为 query 对 token 的 cross-attention" — correct.
3. E042: "After running two blocks, we upsample the image embedding and an MLP maps the output token to a dynamic linear classifier, which then computes the mask foreground probability at each image location." Draft version uses point-wise product per E223. Both are consistent; E223 is the detailed version. Could include both — fine.
4. Text-to-mask prompt: draft says "CLIP 图像嵌入作为 SAM 的首个交互提示" — E180 says "we prompt SAM with the extracted CLIP image embeddings as its first interaction". ok. And "面积大于 100" from E180. ok. But is it "manually collected mask"? E180 says "for each manually collected mask with area larger than 100". ok.
5. The draft says "SA-1B 因此包含 11M 经授权、保护隐私的图像与 1.1B 掩码" ok.
6. Draft includes "此外，文本到掩码的变体..." — this is a variant; fine as it's part of method, but it's actually §7.5, an experiment. It's a training procedure modification. Acceptable but could be kept brief. The instruction says remove unnecessary downstream task lists, quality statistics, and results branches, keep core data engine mechanism. Text-to-mask is a method variant — keep it brief.

Additional things the draft may have missed:
- The training uses "mixture of geometric prompts" (E045) — draft covers via E229/E230.
- Prompt encoder sparse prompts mapped to 256-dim vectorial embeddings (E205). Draft didn't mention 256-dim for prompts. Could add.
- "The image embedding is therefore 64 × 64" ok.
- Draft says "该编码每张图只运行一次、不随提示重复，因此可以承担较大的计算量" — E204: "we can afford a high number of image encoder FLOPs because they are computed only once per image, not per prompt". ok.
- Draft says "image embedding 经转置卷积上采样4×" — E223 says upsample by 4× with two transposed convolutional layers, now downscaled 4× relative to input image. Correct.
- E225: transposed convs 2×2 stride 2 output channels 64 and 32 with GELU, separated by layer norm. Could add but not required.

Potential errors:
- Draft: "模型另用一个头预测每个掩码的 IoU 以便排序（E226）" ok.
- Draft: "训练共 11 轮：1 个初始提示、8 个迭代采样点，以及两次不提供新点、让模型自我修正的迭代（E231）" — E231 says: one sampled initial input prompt, 8 iteratively sampled points, and two iterations where no new external information is supplied. But also mentions testing up to 16. ok. Note "we find diminishing returns after 8 iteratively sampled points". ok.
- Draft: "同时把上一轮未阈值化的 mask logits 也作为提示输入（E230）" ok.
- Draft: "框坐标加入标准差为边长 10%、上限 20 像素的噪声（E229）" ok.
- Data engine: "作者构建 data engine 让模型与标注互相迭代" — E010 "we iterate between using our efficient model to assist in data collection and using the newly collected data to improve the model". ok.

One nuance: The draft claims "此外，文本到掩码的变体在训练时把面积大于 100 的手工标注掩码的 CLIP 图像嵌入作为 SAM 的首个交互提示" — E180 says "for each manually collected mask with area larger than 100 we extract the CLIP image embedding". ok.

Another nuance: E310 describes generating training prompts: expand box randomly 1×–2×, square crop, resize to 336×336, zero out pixels outside mask with 50% probability, masked attention in last layer, prompt is the output token embedding. Could be added. Draft omits. Perhaps include brief.

Also E305: CLIP ViT-L/14@336px used. Could include.

Also note draft says "prompt encoder 与 mask decoder 可在浏览器 CPU 上约 50ms 内完成预测" — E044 says "the prompt encoder and mask decoder run in a web browser, on CPU, in ∼50 ms". ok.

Also draft says "输出 16× 下采样、即 64×64 的图像嵌入" — E205 says 16× downscaled; with 1024 input and /16 patch → 64×64. ok.

Now, the draft also claims ambiguity: "默认 3 个" — E043 says "We found 3 mask outputs is sufficient". ok.

Another: "训练时只对损失最小的那个反传" — E043 "we backprop only the minimum loss over masks". ok; E226 "only backpropagate from the lowest loss". ok.

Missing: the loss "auxiliary deep supervision after each decoder layer is unhelpful" — minor.

Missing: text-to-mask training with large-scale jitter 120k iterations batch 128. Not necessary.

Also the draft should mention: image encoder any network that outputs C×H×W embedding (E204). Minor.

I think draft is quite accurate. Minor corrections/additions:
- prompt embeddings are 256-dimensional (E205).
- decoder: after the two blocks, tokens attend once more to the image embedding before the MLP (E223).
- MLP internal dimension 2048 applied only to prompt tokens; q,k,v reduced by 2× in cross-attention (E224).
- The mask prompts are input at 4× lower resolution than the input image (i.e., 256×256), then downscaled an additional 4× → so total 16× lower. Draft says "以输入图像 1/4 的分辨率输入" — correct per E206.

Hmm wait, is there a contradiction? E206: "We input masks at a 4× lower resolution than the input image, then downscale an additional 4 × using two 2× 2, stride-2 convolutions". Yes.

Also E041: "Dense prompts (i.e., masks) are embedded using convolutions and summed element-wise with the image embedding." ok.

Should I keep "此外，文本到掩码..."? The instruction says keep core data engine, remove results branches. Text-to-mask training procedure is method-ish (§D.5). I'll keep it but compress.

Now about the output format: The instruction says return corrected same-format JSON. The prompt's general instructions mention contribution_novelty blocks only for that section. Here section is method, so use text/sources shape.

Let me write the corrected text, Chinese, 900-1600 characters.

掩码损失是 focal loss 与 dice loss 的线性组合，比例为 20:1；IoU 预测头用均方误差损失训练，以常数 1.0 的权重加到掩码损失上（E228）。训练模拟交互式分割：以相等概率选取一个前景点或目标掩码的包围框作为首个提示；点从真值掩码中均匀采样，框取真值掩码的包围框并在每个坐标上加噪声，噪声标准差为框边长的 10%、上限 20 像素（E229）。后续点从上一轮预测与真值之间的误差区域均匀采样，落在假阴性处作为前景点、假阳性处作为背景点，并把上一轮未阈值化的 mask logits 一并作为提示输入（E230）。模型共训练 11 轮：1 个初始提示、8 个迭代采样点，以及两次不提供新信息、让模型自我修正的迭代（E231）。训练使用 AdamW，90k 次迭代（约 2 个 SA-1B epoch），batch size 256，从 MAE 预训练的 ViT-H 初始化，分布在 256 块 GPU 上，每块 GPU 最多随机取 64 个掩码，并轻度过滤掉覆盖图像 90% 以上的掩码（E236, E238）。

数据方面，互联网上没有现成的分割掩码，作者因此构建 data engine，让模型与数据标注互相迭代，包含 assisted-manual、semi-automatic、fully automatic 三个阶段（E047）。第一阶段由专业标注员在 SAM 驱动的浏览器交互工具中点击前景/背景点来标注掩码，并用像素级 brush 与 eraser 修正；不施加语义约束，按对象显著程度标注，单个掩码超过 30 秒即可进入下一张图（E048）。模型从公开分割数据集起步，之后只用新标注掩码重训，共重训 6 次，image encoder 由 ViT-B 扩到 ViT-H；单掩码平均标注时间从 34 秒降到 14 秒，每图平均掩码数从 20 增至 44，该阶段共从 120k 图像收集 4.3M 掩码（E050）。第二阶段为提升掩码多样性，先用第一阶段掩码训练一个通用"object"类别的包围框检测器以自动检测高置信掩码，标注员在预填这些掩码的图像上补充标注其余对象，新增 5.9M 掩码（总计 10.2M），模型重训 5 次，每图掩码数从 44 升至 72（E050）。第三阶段完全自动：用 32×32 规则点网格提示歧义感知模型，每个点预测一组可能对应有效对象的掩码，由 IoU 预测模块筛出高置信掩码，并只保留稳定掩码（若在 0.5−δ 与 0.5+δ 处阈值化概率图得到相似掩码即视为稳定），再用 NMS 去除重复，另外处理多个重叠的放大裁剪以改善小掩码质量（E050, E052）。该流程应用于全部 11M 图像，共产生 1.1B 掩码，其中 99.1% 完全自动生成（E052, E056）。SA-1B 因此包含 11M 经授权、保护隐私的图像与 1.1B 掩码；图像平均约 3300×4950 像素，发布时最短边下采样到 1500 像素，人脸与车牌被模糊处理，且数据集只包含自动生成的掩码（E014, E056）。

此外，文本提示的变体在训练时对面积大于 100 的手工标注掩码提取 CLIP 图像嵌入，并把它作为 SAM 的首个交互提示；由于 CLIP 的图像嵌入与文本嵌入对齐，推理时可直接把 CLIP 文本编码器输出的文本嵌入作为提示（E180, E313）。
